## Summary

## Type of change
- [ ] New analysis proposal (adds a file under `proposals/`)

## Checklist
- [ ] The change is focused and clearly described.
- [ ] If this adds/accepts an analysis, the proposer is credited in `CONTRIBUTORS.md`.
- [ ] Code (if any) runs locally; new dependencies added to `requirements.txt`.
- [ ] New analyses include data source, query, and retrieval date (no large raw files committed).
- [ ] Docs updated if needed.
- [ ] I agree to release this contribution under the project's MIT license.
